t.zh: 相机形成的像要记录在图像中，还需要确定它落在哪个位置。<wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>给出相对<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>的偏移，而<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>规定了图像中的位置如何计数。在横向坐标条上，先用<wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref>换算单位，再以<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>调整原点，最后将两者组合成<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>相机。
t.en: To record a projected image, a camera must locate it in the image array. <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref> gives an offset from the <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>, while the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref> specifies how image positions are counted. On the horizontal strip, convert units using <wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref>, adjust the origin using the <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>, then compose a <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> camera.

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref>将投影位置与图像坐标联系起来：光路不变，变化的是单位和原点。区分<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>的单位换算与坐标原点的平移，有助于正确表示负偏移。 (<wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref>)
after.en: A <wiki-ref to="pixel-camera"></wiki-ref> relates projected positions to image coordinates: the <wiki-ref to="projection-ray"></wiki-ref> is unchanged, while the units and origin differ. Distinguishing the unit conversion for <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> from the shift of origin helps represent negative offsets correctly.

brief.zh: 横向<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>宽 8 mm、16 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>，物点 X=−1 mm、Z=4 mm，f=2 mm。预测相对<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>的像素偏移。
brief.en: Horizontal <wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>: 8 mm across 16 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> samples; X=−1 mm, Z=4 mm, f=2 mm. Predict the signed image offset in pixel units. (<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>)

hint.zh: 先比较图中的全宽与采样数，再问物理偏移包含多少个<wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref>。保留负号。
hint.en: Compare the full width in the drawing with the sample count, then ask how many intervals of the <wiki-ref to="pixel-pitch"></wiki-ref> fit the physical offset. Keep the negative sign.

why.zh: −0.5 是毫米偏移，不能直接当作<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>偏移。检查后比较同一段长度在两种单位下的读数。
why.en: −0.5 is the physical offset in millimetres, not the offset in <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> units. Compare the two readings of the same length after checking.

brief.zh: 沿用刚验证的偏移 −1 px。图中<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>位于 c_x=7.5；预测从图像原点读取的列坐标。负偏移仍可能落在画面内。
brief.en: Retain the checked offset of −1 px. The <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> is at c_x=7.5; predict the column from the image origin. A negative offset can still be inside the frame.

hint.zh: 从<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>在图中的位置出发，沿着刚验证的偏移向左走；这回要读的是从图像原点计数的位置。
hint.en: Start at the <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> shown on the strip and move left by the checked offset. Read the position from the image origin this time.

why.zh: −1 仍是相对<wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>的偏移，尚未换成图像原点。回到<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>的刻度，从那里向左走一格。
why.en: −1 is still relative to the <wiki-ref to="optical-axis"></wiki-ref>, before changing the origin. Return to the <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> mark and move one unit left from there.

t.zh: 现在要能处理新的<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>、物点和<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>位置。坐标条使用居中的<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>作示例，这块电路的输入 c_x 可以不同；不要写死图像中心。
t.en: Now handle new focal lengths, scene points and principal-point positions. The strip used a centred example; this circuit accepts different c_x values, so do not hard-code the centre. (<wiki-ref to="focal-length"></wiki-ref>) (<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref>) (<wiki-ref to="sensor"></wiki-ref>)

brief.zh: 输入 X、Z、<wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px 和<wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x：交出像点的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>横坐标 u。
brief.en: Given X, Z, the <wiki-ref to="pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref> f_px and the <wiki-ref to="principal-point"></wiki-ref> c_x, give the image's <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> column u.

hint.zh: 先只接带符号的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>偏移，检查 X=0 与 X<0 两种情况，再决定图像原点要怎样平移。
hint.en: First wire only the signed <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> offset. Check X=0 and X<0, then decide how the image origin shifts it.
